bagPolicy.summary: Olympiastadion does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Flatowallee for those coming from different directions. Specific parking options and pricing details are not provided on the website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Olympiastadion's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Aramark Restaurations GmbH provides catering services at the Olympiastadion in Berlin, offering a unique and creative culinary experience for various events. They cater to concerts, sports events, and private occasions, ensuring a diverse range of food and drink options for up to 75,000 spectators.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Olympiastadion, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Olympiastadion's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Olympiastadion. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Olympiastadion. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
